title: River Meadows Park Campground

services.name: Room Rentals
services.desc: River Meadows Park offers three picnic shelters for your enjoyment. Each offers unique features that are sure to meet your picnic needs. All include fire pits with BBQ grate cover, water, and power. Reserve online. IMPORTANT: Reserving a shelter DOES NOT include nor guarantee parking. River Meadows often reaches full-capacity by noon on summer weekends. We encourage you and your guests arrive by 11 a.m. to ensure park entry and a space to park. Shelter 1 measures 24 feet by 36 feet and can seat up to 32 people. Maximum capacity is 50. Adjoining grass open spaces, of approximately 75 feet by 50 feet to the east and 25 feet by 50 feet to the north, are included in the rental. Shelter 2 and 3

blurb: With 150 acres of large open meadows and forests along the banks of the Stillaguamish River, River Meadows is a large, peaceful park with many opportunities to recreate, relax and enjoy nature. You can fish along the mile-long river bank, camp in the summer or rent a yurt year-round, picnic, hike, geocache, bird watch, or play catch in the meadow.
